movers.text: D Quinn Hughes (27.8 TOI, upper body) will miss the rest of Minnesota's road trip, including the SJ game (The Athletic via ESPN, 11/21).
C Connor Bedard (20.1 TOI, shoulder) went on IR 11/22, D Wyatt Kaiser (19.3) got a 3-game suspension 11/22, and D Bowen Byram (24.7) has missed 17 games.
C Ryan Nugent-Hopkins (18.2 TOI) is slated to return vs Vegas on Tuesday after missing 13 games (Oilers TV via ESPN); Zach Hyman (17.2) remains out.
RW Beckett Sennecke (20.3 TOI, upper body) went on IR 11/21 and C Leo Carlsson (19.8, upper body) is day-to-day (The Athletic, 11/22).
LW Artemi Panarin (21.4 TOI) is day-to-day after missing 4 games; D Erik Gustafsson (19.7, 5 missed) and Trevor Moore (16.2) are also day-to-day.
